decisions.reason: Constructing the Unit 1 living-room wall and corridor partition does not change the requirement for one steel entrance door per dwelling.
The source does not replace, remove, or alter the shared use of the existing main entrance door.
The wall-construction decision does not change the open-plan kitchen configuration, cabinetry quantities, or cabinet dimensions.
Constructing a Unit 1 living-room wall does not necessarily change the confirmed 2+1 room program or its room counts.
The source concerns a living-room wall and corridor partition, not the common bathroom's extent, fixtures, or plumbing layout.
The source does not decide whether Unit 1's kitchen and common bathroom locations should be exchanged and therefore does not resolve or modify that requirement.

The source identifies two specific walls to construct but does not revise the general policy of preserving existing walls where possible or any previously recorded color-marked wall action; duplicating the source requirement's wall facts here is unnecessary.
The living-room and corridor walls do not necessarily alter the en-suite arrangement, its fixtures, or its unresolved fit conflict.
The corridor partition decision does not specify any change to the common bathroom door type, opening direction, or collision constraints.
The source does not concern the balcony or its possible incorporation into an adjacent room.
Requesting construction of two walls does not itself require new dimension annotations or modify the existing drawing-annotation requirements.
The Unit 1 and corridor wall decisions do not change the required subdivision into three dwellings.
